script_text: This week, Uranus slams your 10th House in a sharp angle, and your entire career will pivot overnight. Monday, Uranus squares Mercury in the 2nd House, making money and communication feel deeply chaotic. Tuesday, Uranus trines Venus in the 11th House, bringing an unexpected and romantic breakthrough among friends. Wednesday, Uranus squares Saturn in the 4th House, leaving your home life feeling completely unstable. Mid-week, Uranus hits your 7th House with a square to Mars, igniting a sudden and fierce drive to pursue long-cherished ambitions. Thursday, Uranus forms a trine with the Sun in the 10th House, aligning your career with your deepest and most profound purpose. Friday, Uranus conjuncts the Moon in the 5th House, sparking unexpected and intense love chemistry. Saturday, Uranus squares Pluto in the 1st House, shaking your sense of deep identity. Wednesday is your power day because Uranus enters your 5th House, opening a channel for creative confidence. Channel the chaos by journaling your Uranus square Saturn tension each evening. Follow for daily updates.
